preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 5000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 100 and 2 <= m <= 100 for n, m in (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, n and m are integers between 2 and 100 inclusive, representing the dimensions of the binary table.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1'))
preconditions.description: Each row of the binary table has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1'))
preconditions.description: Each character in the binary table is either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m in (map(int, line.split()) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1'))) <= 20000
preconditions.description: The sum of n*m for all test cases does not exceed 20000.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == 1 + k for k in (int(stdout_lines[0]) if stdout_lines else 0) for stdout_lines in (line.splitlines() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output consists of k+1 lines: the first line is the integer k (number of operations), followed by k lines of 6 integers each.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= n * m for k in (int(stdout_lines[0]) if stdout_lines else 0) for stdout_lines in (line.splitlines() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
postconditions.description: The number of operations k for each test case is between 0 and n*m inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= m for x, y in (line.split()[::2], line.split()[1::2]) for line in stdout_lines[1:]) for stdout_lines in (line.splitlines() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
postconditions.description: Each operation's coordinates (x, y) are within the bounds of the table (1 ≤ x ≤ n, 1 ≤ y ≤ m).

postconditions.expression: all(len(set((int(x1), int(y1), int(x2), int(y2), int(x3), int(y3))) & {(int(x1), int(y1)), (int(x2), int(y2)), (int(x3), int(y3))}) == 3 for line in stdout_lines[1:] for stdout_lines in (line.splitlines() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
postconditions.description: Each operation selects three distinct cells.

postconditions.expression: all(any((abs(int(x1) - int(x2)) <= 1 and abs(int(y1) - int(y2)) <= 1) for x1, y1, x2, y2 in [(line.split()[0], line.split()[1], line.split()[2], line.split()[3]), (line.split()[0], line.split()[1], line.split()[4], line.split()[5]), (line.split()[2], line.split()[3], line.split()[4], line.split()[5])]) for line in stdout_lines[1:] for stdout_lines in (line.splitlines() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('0') and not line.startswith('1')))
postconditions.description: The three cells in each operation belong to some 2×2 square.

postconditions.expression: all(all(line[i] == '0' for line in table) for table in (apply_operations(initial_table, operations) for initial_table, operations in (parse_table_and_operations(stdout_lines, stdin_lines) for stdin_lines, stdout_lines in (split_input_output(stdin, stdout)))))
postconditions.description: After applying all operations, every cell in the table is '0'.
